tools.description: Report redacted local configuration. Set verify=true to check AWS metadata access; local status alone does not prove database connectivity.

verify.description: When true, verify AWS access with a bounded metadata request. Default false is local only.

tools.name: connection_status

tools.description: Submit plain EXPLAIN for a SELECT/WITH query and return a query handle. Supply SQL without the EXPLAIN prefix. Retrieve the plan through query_status and query_results; no ANALYZE execution mode is supported.

name.description: Named placeholder without its leading colon; names are case-sensitive.

value.description: Nonempty string value. Use a SQL cast when a type is required.

request_id.description: Optional stable request key for retrying the same submission within this process.

sql.description: One supported read-only SQL query. Do not submit multiple statements.

timeout_ms.description: Optional warehouse statement timeout in milliseconds, capped by operator configuration.

tools.name: explain_query

tools.description: Describe columns for one exact schema and table/view name, with type, nullability and precision metadata. Continue for wide objects using the cursor.

name.description: Exact table or view name, not a LIKE pattern.

schema.description: Exact schema name, not a LIKE pattern.

tools.name: get_object_details

tools.description: List accessible databases on the configured target. Queries remain bound to the operator-configured database. Continue using the returned cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from this same operation and server process.

limit.description: Maximum items in this page, bounded by the operator's configured row limit.

tools.name: list_databases

tools.description: List tables and views in the configured database. schema and pattern are SQL LIKE patterns, not exact identifiers; percent and underscore are wildcards.

pattern.description: Optional object name LIKE pattern; percent and underscore are wildcards.

schema.description: Optional schema LIKE pattern; percent and underscore are wildcards.

tools.name: list_objects

tools.description: List accessible schemas in the configured database, optionally filtered by an SQL LIKE pattern. Percent and underscore are wildcards.

pattern.description: Optional AWS SQL LIKE schema pattern; percent and underscore are wildcards.

tools.name: list_schemas

tools.description: Request cancellation of a query owned by this server process. This changes query state; accepted cancellation is not confirmed termination. Check query_status afterwards.

query_id.description: Opaque query handle returned by this server process, never an AWS statement ID.

tools.name: query_cancel

tools.description: Fetch a bounded tuple-row page from a finished query. Preserve the query_id and use the returned cursor to continue without skipping rows or executing the SQL again.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned for this query.

limit.description: Maximum rows in this page, bounded by operator configuration.

tools.name: query_results

tools.description: Submit a read-only query, wait briefly, and return its handle and state. A finished query also includes the first bounded result page. Default wait is 1000 ms; maximum 10000 ms.

name.description: Named placeholder without its leading colon; names are case-sensitive.

value.description: Nonempty string value. Use a SQL cast when a type is required.

limit.description: Maximum rows in the first page if the query finishes within the wait.

wait_ms.description: Brief wait after submission: default 1000 ms, maximum 10000 ms. Pending work returns a handle.

tools.name: query_sql

tools.description: Submit a single read-only query and return a private process-local query handle. Use a stable request_id to retry the same submission; poll status, retrieve pages, or cancel using the handle.

name.description: Named placeholder without its leading colon; names are case-sensitive.

value.description: Nonempty string value. Use a SQL cast when a type is required.

request_id.description: Optional stable request key for retrying the same submission within this process.

sql.description: One supported read-only SQL query. Do not submit multiple statements.

timeout_ms.description: Optional warehouse statement timeout in milliseconds, capped by operator configuration.

tools.name: query_start

tools.description: Inspect a query submitted by this server process. Pending, finished, failed and aborted are distinct states; a transport timeout does not mean the query stopped.

query_id.description: Opaque query handle returned by this server process, never an AWS statement ID.

tools.name: query_status

tools.description: Validate one read-only Redshift query and its named parameters locally. This checks supported syntax and the function allowlist, not database objects, permissions or execution cost.

name.description: Named placeholder without its leading colon; names are case-sensitive.

value.description: Nonempty string value. Use a SQL cast when a type is required.

parameters.description: Bind every distinct :name placeholder once. Values must be nonempty strings.

sql.description: One SELECT/WITH query or plain EXPLAIN query in the supported Redshift dialect.

tools.name: validate_sql
